integrity: The finite certificate is fully reproducible with two standalone Python 3 standard-library programs; one computes exact integral ranks, the other independent modular ranks.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the 42 standard Young tableaux of 3-by-3 square shape; not a general statement for arbitrary shapes or unlabelled observations. Literature coverage is bounded; no independent audit performed.
title: Quartic Fourier recovery and the unique cubic blind alternant of three-by-three standard Young tableaux
